summary: The note is a short biography of Tim DuBois, a Nashville, Tennessee-based music executive born May 4, 1948 in Southwest City, Missouri. It covers his education at Oklahoma State University, where he earned a B.A. and M.A. in Accounting, and his later move into the music business across songwriting, record labels, management, and production. It also notes that he has received numerous honors for his contributions to the industry.
one_line: Tim DuBois is a Nashville-based music executive with an accounting background who has worked across songwriting, labels, management, and production.
